title: Density comparison (Simon 1.3.3) for an arbitrary measure, with the sharp isodiametric constant
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and assume the isodiametric normalisation (IB): μHE[n] ≤ (ω_n/2ⁿ)·μH[n] as measures on ℝ^P = Euclid P. Here ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the volume of the open unit ball of ℝⁿ and μH[n] is Mathlib's unnormalised n-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Let μ be an arbitrary measure on ℝ^P, A ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary (not necessarily measurable) set, and t ∈ (0, ∞] such that t < limsup_{r→0+} μ(B̄_r(x))/(ω_n·rⁿ) for every x ∈ A. The quotients are taken in [0, ∞], with ω_n·rⁿ written unitBallVolume n * ofReal(rⁿ). Then t·μHE[n](A) ≤ μ(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) ≤ (unitBallVolume n / 2 ^ n) • (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Euclid P)) → 0 < t → (∀ x ∈ A, t < limsup (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → t * μHE[n] A ≤ μ univ
